AGORAGENTIC_API_KEY.how_to_get: POST https://agoragentic.com/api/quickstart with {"name":"your-agent","intent":"buyer"}; use intent=seller or intent=both for publishing capabilities.
AGORAGENTIC_API_KEY.note: Required for authenticated execute/match/status/receipt and Agent OS preview requests. Anonymous stable x402 edge calls do not require a platform API key.

AGORAGENTIC_RUST_AGENT_URL.how_to_get: Run a local agoragentic-rust HTTP runtime; defaults to http://127.0.0.1:8080.
AGORAGENTIC_RUST_AGENT_URL.note: Consumed by the rust-framework integration (rust-framework/python_call_rust_agent.py). Its own install string instructs setting this var.

AGORAGENTIC_BASE_URL.how_to_get: Set only to override the default platform base URL.
AGORAGENTIC_BASE_URL.note: Overrides https://agoragentic.com. Read across many integrations (e.g. agent-os/agent_os_node.mjs).

AGORAGENTIC_SUPERVISOR_API_KEY.how_to_get: Provision a supervisor-mode API key from the Agoragentic dashboard.
AGORAGENTIC_SUPERVISOR_API_KEY.note: Required for Agent OS supervisor mode. Documented in agent-os/README.md.

AGORAGENTIC_CAPABILITY_ID.how_to_get: Copy the capability/listing ID from the Agoragentic marketplace listing you want to quote or execute.
AGORAGENTIC_CAPABILITY_ID.note: Required for Agent OS buyer mode. Documented in agent-os/README.md.

agent_os_smart_routing.summary: Triptych OS (Agent OS) combines model routing, parallel routing, and marketplace routing under one deployment policy boundary.

model_routing.description: Choose cheaper models for simple work, balanced models for normal reasoning, and stronger models only when risk, validation failure, or policy requires escalation.

parallel_routing.description: Keep a goal sequential or split it into bounded branches with context slices, consequence review, budgets, receipts, and a merge path.

marketplace_routing.description: Route external work through provider matching, trust constraints, cost caps, receipts, and settlement instead of hardcoded provider IDs.

agent_os_smart_routing.machine_rule: Prefer execute(task,input,constraints) for external work; honor model_policy and parallel_policy when present.

inventory_holds.reason: The offline conformance scorer is source-visible, but its run records are self-attested and it has no independent harness evidence, leaderboard approval, or publication review.

The exact upstream source lock, closed representation contract, no-spend target policy, and deterministic fixture replay pass, but no live MatrAIx provider run or independent external compatibility review has occurred.

The provider-neutral qualification evaluator, closed evidence schema, fail-closed regression handling, and no-auto-promotion tests are source-visible. It is not published, deployed, authorized to execute integrations, or sufficient by itself to prove runtime compatibility, hosted availability, production activation, or human promotion.

A hash-bound, provider-free run against exact Prime Agent v0.7.2 records verified release bytes, a pinned dependency closure, the loaded source extension, and a passed RPC matrix as runtime-compatibility evidence. Promotion is blocked because the exact closure includes direct extract-zip 2.0.1, affected by high-severity GHSA-jmr9-qjv8-65gv with no patched version reported at capture time. A public compatibility claim, real host tool-call interception, restricted exact-runtime containment, hosted availability, and production activation remain unapproved or unverified, so the effective level stays source_adapter and the package stays held from public catalog inclusion.

A signed independent anchor-x402 run against historical suite 0.1.0-alpha.0 and pinned target and suite commits passed 42/42 with a publicly verified receipt, no network use, and no spend authority, and produced two actionable contract-clarity findings. Current suite 0.2.0-alpha.0 adds seven required negative/review vectors and needs fresh independent artifacts; starter self-tests cannot satisfy that gate. The package also includes optional read-only Mycelium external-verification profiles. Publication, public catalog inclusion, and any ecosystem-standard or live-compatibility claim remain separately review-gated.
Exact Prime Verifiers v0.3.0 package tests pass, but an owner-approved external harness attestation run is still required before public catalog inclusion.

The public integrity-bound enforcement bundle is source-only and unpublished; it supplies reviewed library source with source/loopback ordering evidence but no production host adapter, credentials, deployment authority, or traffic-routing authority. This repository contains no immutable public-safe evidence ref/hash establishing a separate private host-control release, its interface inventory, current deployment/runtime state, live interception, or qualified production traffic, so those private and runtime states remain unknown here.
